title: Vtg Taco Bell 2002 Sticker Activity Set Discover Frontier Times - Sealed
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Fast Food & Cereal Premiums:Fast Food
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Taco Bell 2002 sticker activity set that allows kids to "Discover Frontier Times" at the fast food chain's restaurant. It includes individual pieces suitable for children aged 3 and up. The set features characters from the Taco Bell franchise and is gender-neutral, making it appealing to both boys and girls. This collectible item is sealed and has not been modified from its original form, offering a nostalgic look back at the popular fast food chain's promotions from the early 2000s.
